To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the p-wave multipoels E2,M2 in the reaction γp → π+ n are small and that the spin-dependent part of the nucleon polarizabilities is of similar magnitude as the spin-independent one.

the p-wave multipoels in charged pion photo-production are dominated by pion exchange, that spin-dependent effects in unpolarized Compton scattering are dominated by dynamical spin polarisabilites, that the dynamical spin polarizations are dominated by the spin-dependent part of the pion-nucleon sigma term, and that this part is small, of order 10% of the pion mass.
a) the p-wave multipoels in pion photoprodution are dominated by pion rescattering and b) the dynamical spin polarizations in Compton scattering can be understood in terms of the chiral expansion.
